description:
Rust player leaderboard: most kills, best K/D, hours and more. The leaderboard on https://rust.wiki/players: Rust players ranked by their official Steam stats.
Boards: `kills`, `kd` (min 1,000 kills), `headshots` (headshots on anything), `hours` (public playtime only),
`accuracy` (bullets that hit a player / fired, min 20,000 fired), `scientists`, `animals`, `gathered` (wood +
stone + metal ore + sulfur ore), `building` (blocks placed), `rockets`, `fish`, `deaths`. Each result has
`rank`, `steamid`, `name`, `avatar`, `country`, `value` / `value_text`, `kills`, `deaths`, `kd`, `hours` and
`updated` (the date its stats were last read from Steam). Players are added when looked up on Player Stats or
when their inventory is checked on rust.wiki, refreshed about weekly; only public game details are ranked and
accounts with VAC or game bans never are. `total` is how many players qualify for the board.
name: get_player_leaderboard
